title: Normalize or reject an unsorted or null ProfileOptions.IncludeValuesFor
lead: The init path of ProfileOptions (promoted in the user guide by sq-49) stores the allow-list as given: the writer emits it in that order (DescriptorWriter.cs, includeValuesFor) and `required` does not stop `= null!`. The old positional constructor had the same hole, so this is not a regression, but a descriptor made from an unsorted list differs from one made through `Create`. Decide whether the profiler normalizes (sort, de-duplicate) or rejects, or documents it; a descriptor change here is a minor change to document.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Owner decision on normalise vs reject vs document; 2. failing test with an unsorted list and with null; 3. implement; 4. docs.

Owner decisions (2026-11-02, spec check sq-58 Q1), verbatim: "Normalize (Recommended)" (option text: "Profiler sorts ordinal and drops duplicates; null throws SqualifyException. Bytes change only for hand-built unsorted lists; no schema change; matches the docs."). Spec check notes: the `ProfileOptions` record stays as is (NonPositionalRecordsTests asserts order-sensitive equality); Profile normalizes before building `Descriptor.Options`. Files: `src/squalify/Profiler.cs` (Validate/ProfileCore) or a helper in `src/squalify/Descriptor/Options.cs`; tests `OrdinalTests.cs`, `NonPositionalRecordsTests.cs`, `ValuesTierTests.cs`; docs `docs/user-guide.md` (values policy and a labelled 1.1 entry), `docs/descriptor.md` includeValuesFor wording. Failing tests: `Profile_UnsortedIncludeValuesFor_WritesSortedOptions`, `Profile_DuplicateIncludeValuesFor_WritesOnce`, `Profile_NullIncludeValuesFor_ThrowsSqualifyException` (NullReferenceException today), `Profile_ByNameUnsorted_ByteIdenticalToCreate`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
